34/S0.subgoal: Identify the three key concerns that must be addressed when building the Majuli VR system.

34/S1.subgoal: Describe the various types of tangible and intangible cultural heritage aspects of Majuli Island.

34/S2.subgoal: Explain the methodology, data types, and statistics used to capture the island's cultural landscape.

34/S3.subgoal: Discuss the major challenges related to system design, scale, and user experience in creating the virtual tour.

34/S4.subgoal: Summarize the lecture content and preview how future lessons will address the identified challenges.
